anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The sheep slaughtered in Egypt as type.
The light in the darkness — possible.

choices.why: Witte's restored etymology of Pharaoh; keep it.

pass_a_gloss: For from the slavery of the world-ruler of this darkness of this age the true sheep has set free, which is Christ Jesus, of whom a type came to be the sheep slaughtered in Egypt, having delivered the then Hebrews from the authority of the then ruler of Egypt, which is called darkness, and Pharaoh scatterer, who scatters the works in light of virtue through his ruling authority, that is of a mind of those living in darkness.
pass_b_english: For the true sheep, which is Christ Jesus, of whom the sheep slaughtered in Egypt became a type, has set free from the slavery of the world-ruler of this darkness of this age, having delivered the Hebrews of that time from the authority of the then ruler of Egypt, which is called darkness, and Pharaoh "scatterer," who scatters the works that are in the light of virtue through his ruling authority — that is, of a mind of those living in darkness.
source_text: Τῆς γὰρ δουλείας τοῦ κοσμοκράτορος τοῦ σκότος τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος ἀπήλλαξεν τὸ ἀληθινὸν πρόβατον, ὅ ἐστιν Χ(ριστὸ)ς Ἰ(ησοῦ)ς, οὗ τύπος ἐγένετο <τὸ> ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ σφαγὲν πρόβατον, ῥυσάμενος τοὺς τότε Ἑβραίους ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ τότε ἄρχοντος Αἰγύπτου, ὃ καλεῖται σκότος, Φαραὼ δ<ὲ δ>ιασκεδαστής, ὃς διασκεδαννύει τὰ ἐν φωτὶ τῆς ἀρετῆς ἔργα διὰ τῆς αὐτοῦ ἀρχοντικῆς ἐξουσίας, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν διανοίας ἐν σκότει ζώντων.
